name: Makurazaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Makurazaki city emblem in black: a ring with two curved horns enclosing a stylised letter C.
history: Municipal flag of Makurazaki, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 September 1949.

features.role: Makurazaki city emblem — a ring with two curved horns enclosing a stylised letter C
